data.rationale: The proposal is a different procedure (SEC EDGAR 10-K and Wikipedia lookup, then an emailed brief) from the true one (timeanddate time zone converter and holidays, then a drafted and discarded sync email), so only the final compose-an-email step is loosely similar; as a spec it is fairly concrete but automates the wrong task.
